content.description: A compact always-on-top macOS companion for estimating Claude Code token burn rate in intervals
content.intro: Built to track token burn rate in real time so I could gauge when I'd hit my Claude Pro limit during active coding sessions.
content.body: A native macOS menubar app that sits always on top and displays live token burn rate and usage stats for active Claude Code sessions without API keys or network requests.
content.conclusion: Check the GitHub repository for installation instructions and source code.
content.imageAltText: Screenshot of Burn Gauge macOS app showing Claude Code token usage

content.description: AI-powered translation web application built with OpenAI API integration
content.intro: Developed to demonstrate LLM API integration and asynchronous request handling in a practical application.
content.body: Implemented OpenAI API calls, error handling, and responsive UI using vanilla JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
content.conclusion: See the GitHub repository for API integration patterns and implementation details.

content.description: Interactive study guide designed as PWA for studying on the go
